correctness.rationale: The positive Bateman impulse response and exact derivative prove a unique terminal maximum. The lag derivative is strictly negative for all positive L; analytic endpoint expansions establish inverse range and conditioning. A verified exact polynomial factorization has exactly one interior root in z, establishing the single crossover. Supplementary standard-library/SymPy code checks the identity and examples.

value.rationale: The complete duration-dependent reversal of two independently measurable downstream peak times is a motivated ordering question, and its exact one-crossover example and robust open rate condition show a false all-duration sentinel-ranking inference. Strict inversion and asymptotic ill-conditioning provide an explicit identifiability boundary for long blooms. The result is theoretical, not a field-calibrated risk recommendation.
